d5475.Raw_Article: 5475 Ta. veṭi (-v-, -nt-), viṭi (-v-, -nt-) to dawn, break as day; veṭiyal, veṭivu, viṭi, viṭiyal, viṭivu, viṭivai break of day, dawn; veṭṭa clear, plain; veṭṭam light; veṭṭaviṭi break of day, early dawn; veṭṭa-veḷi open plain; veṭṭa-veḷiccam broad daylight. Ma. veṭikka the weather to clear up; veṭippu cleared off, gone; veṭṭa, veṭṭam light; veṭṭaveḷivu clearness. ? Ko. vart viṛ- (viṭ-) day breaks. ? To. koš fïṛ- (fïṭ-) to dawn; ko·s föṭy(k) lamp lit in funeral hut (for ko·s , see 1458). Te. viḍi clearness, transparency, brilliancy; clear, transparent. Malt. biḍye to shine; biḍe to shoot forth (as rays). DED (S) 4504.
